args.name: units-001.json
args.section_json:
[
  {
    "id": "U01",
    "path": "plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.ts",
    "action": "edit",
    "phase": "codegen",
    "behaviour": "Resolve cross-step JSON Schema dependencies and if/then/else conditions against formData and identify cross-step hidden property keys",
    "rules": [
      "1. Preserve existing isObject, extractUiSchema, extractSchemaFromStep, and createFieldValidation implementations without changing their signatures or behavior.",
      "2. Add internal helper stripUndefined(data: JsonObject): JsonObject that returns a copy of data omitting keys whose value is undefined (recursing into nested JsonObjects).",
      "3. Add internal helper normalizeConditionSchema(schema: JsonObject): JsonObject that clones schema, sets type to 'object' when properties is an object, adds every key of properties whose value is an object without a 'not' property into required, and recurses on nested properties, allOf, anyOf, and oneOf.",
      "4. Add internal helper matchesSchemaCondition(conditionSchema: JsonObject, formData: JsonObject): boolean that validates stripUndefined(formData) against normalizeConditionSchema(conditionSchema) using new JSONSchema(normalized).isValid(cleanData).",
      "5. Add internal helper isDependencyTruthy(value: JsonValue | undefined): boolean that returns true when value is not undefined, null, false, '', or an empty array.",
      "6. Add internal helper getConditionKeys(conditionSchema: JsonObject): string[] that collects property names referenced in conditionSchema.properties, conditionSchema.required, and recursively in conditionSchema.allOf, conditionSchema.anyOf, conditionSchema.oneOf, and conditionSchema.not.",
      "7. Export collectAllSchemaKeys(steps: Pick<ParsedTemplateSchema, 'mergedSchema'>[]): Set<string> that traverses each step's mergedSchema (properties, dependencies, then, else, allOf, oneOf, anyOf) and returns the set of all defined property keys (excluding condition-only keys inside 'if' blocks)."

The change specification for `20261103-feature-extend-scaffolder-conditional-fields` has been submitted and validated:

- **`header.json`** — conventions, architectural decisions, per-file `eslint` and `test` checks, and the full project verification check.
- **`units-001.json` (`U01`–`U13`)**:
  - **Codegen (`U01`–`U05`)**:
    - [schema.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.ts) (`U01`): adds [`resolveConditionalSchema`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.ts), [`resolveStepSchema`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.ts), [`collectCrossStepHiddenKeys`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.ts), and [`collectAllSchemaKeys`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.ts).
    - [createAsyncValidators.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/Stepper/createAsyncValidators.ts) (`U02`): resolves conditional branches against `formData` and skips inactive conditional fields during async validation.
    - [Stepper.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/Stepper/Stepper.tsx) (`U03`): resolves per-step schemas against `stepsState` and prunes values of fields hidden by cross-step conditions while preserving same-step conditional field values.
    - [util.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/util.ts) (`U04`) & [ReviewState.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/ReviewState.tsx) (`U05`): resolves cross-step `dependencies` and `if`/`then`/`else` schemas in [`findSchemaForKey`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/util.ts#L35-L76) and [`ReviewState`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/ReviewState.tsx#L92-L109), omitting inactive conditional fields.
  - **Tests (`U06`–`U10`)**:
    - [schema.test.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.test.ts) (`U06`), [createAsyncValidators.test.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/Stepper/createAsyncValidators.test.ts) (`U07`), [util.test.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/util.test.ts) (`U08`), [ReviewState.test.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/ReviewState.test.tsx) (`U09`), and [Stepper.test.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/Stepper/Stepper.test.tsx) (`U10`).
  - **Docs & Changeset (`U11`–`U13`)**:
    - [input-examples.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/docs/features/software-templates/input-examples.md) (`U11`), [writing-templates.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/docs/features/software-templates/writing-templates.md) (`U12`), and [.changeset/scaffolder-cross-step-conditional-fields.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/.changeset/scaffolder-cross-step-conditional-fields.md) (`U13`).
